text:
Audemars Piguet's new Royal Oak Jumbo uses a metal that acts like glass.

Its shiny bezel and middle links are bulk metallic glass, a palladium alloy cooled so fast its atoms never line up. The case is titanium, and the dial is smoked burgundy. Price is on request from AP.

The case is 39 mm wide and 8.1 mm thick, with an automatic movement. A one-off watch in this metal was made for the Only Watch charity auction in 2021.
